commands.name: ship
commands.title: Ship the release
commands.description: Merge the newest green PR on over-the-shoulder and publish a GitHub release with notes
commands.author: pranav
steps: Open the newest open pull request in the list (the top one when sorted Newest)
Confirm every check passed (Conversation tab checks box shows all green); if any check failed or is still running, call finish and report it instead of merging
Open Files changed and read the diff so the release notes describe it accurately
Merge with Create a merge commit: choose that option in the merge dropdown if needed, click it, then Confirm merge
Open https://github.com/PranavAchar01/over-the-shoulder/releases and read the latest release tag (none means the next tag is v0.1.0; otherwise bump the minor version, v0.1.0 to v0.2.0)

Open https://github.com/PranavAchar01/over-the-shoulder/releases/new, type the new tag and choose Create new tag on publish, target main, title it with the tag, and write 2 to 4 short lines of notes from the PR title and diff
Click Publish release, then call finish with the release URL

commands.name: standup

steps: Open the commit history of main in PranavAchar01/over-the-shoulder
Read the commits from the last 24 hours
Open the pull requests tab and note what is open or merged
Open the issues tab and note anything new or blocked
Write a 4-line standup: Yesterday, Today, Next, Blockers, about this repo only

commands.name: triage
commands.title: Triage new issues
commands.description: Label every unlabeled open issue on over-the-shoulder with a type and a priority, and ask for repro steps when missing
commands.author: pranav
steps: Open https://github.com/PranavAchar01/over-the-shoulder/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+no%3Alabel and list every open issue with no labels
Open each of those issues in turn and read its title and body
In the Labels menu of the issue, pick exactly one type label (bug, feature or perf) and exactly one priority (P1 if it breaks a core flow or the demo, else P2), then close the menu to save
Only if it is a bug or perf issue with no steps to reproduce: also add needs-repro and post a one-line comment asking for the exact steps to reproduce
Never close an issue, never assign anyone, never edit a title or body; go back to the list and repeat until no unlabeled open issue is left
Call finish with one line per issue: #number title: labels added (and repro asked when you commented)

commands.name: deploys
commands.title: Latest production deploy
commands.description: Read the latest Vercel production deployment of over-the-shoulder: status, age, commit, duration, warnings
commands.author: pranav
steps: On the project overview, find the Production Deployment panel and open the latest production deployment
Read its status (Ready, Error, Building or Canceled), how long ago it was created, and the build duration
Read the commit it was built from: short sha and commit message
Open Build Logs and note any warning lines (none is a valid answer)
Call finish with a 3-line report: status and age, commit, duration and warnings. Read only: never redeploy, promote or change settings
